name: Check room/unit price
description: Check room/unit price for specific date

function.name: check_price
function.description: Check room/unit price for specific dates.

dates.description: Date range in format yyyy-mm-dd -> yyyy-mm-dd

mock_response:
unit_name = args['unit_name']
dates = args['dates']
parts = [s.strip() for s in dates.split('->')]
start = datetime.strptime(parts[0], '%Y-%m-%d')
end = datetime.strptime(parts[1], '%Y-%m-%d')
prices = []
total = 0
d = start
while d < end:
    is_weekend = d.weekday() >= 5
    price = 1200000 if is_weekend else 850000
    prices.append({'date': d.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'), 'price': price, 'available': True})
    total += price
    d += timedelta(days=1)
result = {'unit_name': unit_name, 'dates': dates, 'currency': 'IDR', 'prices': prices, 'total': total, 'nights': len(prices)}
